pages.text: $(item)XP Gun$() — «There it is~ it's coming out...»$(br2)Each shot consumes 5 experience points and sprays out 5 XP orbs. Who says experience has to be earned the hard way?
$(item)Retriever$() — «Pull it out, then put it back in.» Use on a creature with a rod inside to retrieve that rod.

$(item)Insertion Pedestal$() — load a rod into the pedestal and sneakily give someone a surprise. Right-click an insertable target to install; interact again to retrieve. «It won't fit, no matter what» (if there's already one).
$(item)Panties Getter$() and $(item)Panties$() — a wonderful gadget chain for obtaining and wearing panties. The $(item)Diaper$() is wearable legwear too~
